items.title: 22.2 Key statistical measures and their calculation

blocks.text: In the field of statistics, understanding and calculating key measures is essential for summarizing and interpreting data. These measures provide valuable insights into the central tendency, variability, and distribution of data, helping to identify patterns and make informed decisions. The mean represents the average value, the median indicates the middle point, and the mode highlights the most frequent value of dataset. Standard deviation and range measure the spread and dispersion of data, while percentiles break the data into specific intervals for a deeper analysis.
